title: The Impact of Treatments for Depression on the Dynamic Network Structure of Mental States: Two Randomized Controlled Trials
sample_size: Imipramine trial: 50 participants; Mind-Maastricht trial: 119 participants
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample; - No follow-up ESM assessments; - No data on medication adherence; - Limited range of positive emotions measured
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. The authors mention using permutation testing procedures for statistical inference, but do not specify if the hypotheses were preregistered. The code for statistical analysis is declared available, but the data is not explicitly stated to be publicly available.
